<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a resource that's necessary in order to perform research at the [[study table]], never actually possessed by the player as an item, similar to how {{Fuel}} is consumed to perform certain crafting tasks at the [[oven]] or [[furnace]]s. To obtain science, simply research any of a wide array of paper products, or the late-game relatively-precious [[Lens]], in the study table.
